improvements: Current native scene retains 828 source building records and validates the source geometry cache; no membership count establishes architectural parity.
Physical camera approach; manual facade shutters; actual 176.285 m continuous source-sidewalk course with immediate pause/map/conditions cancellation and persistence
The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.

District fidelity pass, f9787fa (range 332ae423..346f7986): Parliament hill and its perimeter wall were built: from Piata Constitutiei the palace now stands behind the wall with its railing instead of an open fence line.

Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): The grounds wall (OSM w94522653) is a solid cream stone wall with relief panels and closed iron gates at its thirteen mapped gate nodes, an iron grille on Bd. Natiunile Unite; the hill starts at the wall instead of carrying the outside streets. Izvor park fence, the garage block and the far park canopy were added.

Fidelity pass round 3, 2b1a251 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511): 25 venue name signs on Bd. Unirii and Calea 13 Septembrie, the Memorial Revolutie as a white marble wedge and plain ground floors on 463 outlines without mapped shops.
